summary:
Saudi Arabia extended the suspension of all flights at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Monday after another Houthi attack. Saturday's strike was the deadliest attack in a Gulf Arab country since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began in February, and a second strike on Sunday killed at least one person while Dammam airport was also hit. Iran's Foreign Ministry said 14 people had died in two days of Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport and offered to help facilitate dialogue between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia.

Donald Trump announced an energy ceasefire in Ukraine's war on social media, which Volodymyr Zelenskyy said was 'news to me'. Less than 24 hours later Ukraine reported Russian strikes on Kharkiv, and Zelenskyy said Russia had violated the truce. The Kremlin said it would only consider a one-day ceasefire for an election and rejected a 60-day total ceasefire proposed by Zelenskyy.

An overcrowded boat sank on the night of October 8 and 9 on its way from Djibouti to Yemen. The International Organization for Migration said at least 139 people died, including 15 children, and 84 are missing, and most of those on board were Ethiopian. A UN agency cited by RFI gave a lower toll of 109 dead and 116 missing, and said more than 80 people survived.

Saturday's strike was the deadliest attack in a Gulf Arab country since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began in February, and a second strike on Sunday killed at least one person.

headlines.title: Russia accused of violating Trump's Ukraine energy ceasefire

headlines.title: Migrant boat sinks between Djibouti and Yemen, killing over 100

headlines.title: Opposition marches to Supreme Court demanding election chief's resignation
headlines.summary: Opposition parties led by Congress marched to the Supreme Court demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The march followed a weekend in which police detained thousands of protesters in New Delhi.

headlines.title: EU to cap Chinese hybrid car imports at 350,000 a year
headlines.summary: The EU will limit imports of Chinese hybrid electric vehicles to 350,000 a year, aiming to halve China's market share in the bloc over four years. The deal, unveiled on Friday, also slashes Chinese tariffs on a variety of European goods.

headlines.title: Hall and Woodford win 2026 Nobel economics prize
headlines.summary: Americans Robert E. Hall of Stanford University and Michael Woodford of Columbia University won the 2026 Nobel economics prize. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences said their macroeconomic models have significantly improved the ability to implement effective stabilisation policy.

headlines.title: Hurricane Simon batters Mexico's Pacific coast as Category 3 storm
headlines.summary: Hurricane Simon pounded Mexico's Pacific coast as a Category 3 storm on Sunday, bringing heavy rain and strong winds. Its most powerful winds and rain slammed people living between the Sierra Madre and the ocean.

headlines.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles, its fourth launch in October
headlines.summary: North Korea fired multiple ballistic missiles from the Pyongyang area, and one flew more than 900km, South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said. South Korea's military called the launch a 'show of force' in response to Seoul's successful hypersonic missile test.
